notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.0d
notes.content:
There's always that time at the end of a live project like this (with regular updates) when the can you've been kicking down the road has run out of road. Since the release out of Early Access we've been hard at work fixing small bugs, typos and quality of life updates.

A huge thanks to the discord team of native Ukrainian (Olga), Italian (Andrea) and Spanish (Maria) speakers who've gone through the text and helped spot little inconsistencies. The big one (that Andrea is actually a boy's name in Italian), I'm going to write off as her father wanting a son. Sorry, Andrea.

We've improved the quest/hint system to clear out a lot of common places people get stuck, added options for exporting more stuff as wallpapers, and cleaned up lots of little buglets. A huge thanks to everyone who reported them!

There's also a bit of new content, with a new painting for Maria (based on a poll we ran on Patreon), and Cath & Gabby's repeatable threesome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/02c8b912013f163553f30934898e7f1ee71ab659.png[/img]

Paradise Lust also racked up some positive feedback this week, with Adult Gaming site [url=https://www.spicygaming.net/blog-article/277]SpicyGaming [/url]ranking it as the #1 best recently released adult game on steam.

With that we're back to working on Sinners Landing and Paradise Lust 2. Busy days indeed. If you've enjoyed Paradise Lust, don't forget to give them a wishlist!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.26.0d
notes.content:
We've managed to reproduce the issue that was causing some savegames to not load properly; 0.26.0d should fix it for good.

For those who are curious *why* this was happening; in the rest version we added achievements. Unfortunately that added some additional data fields for tracking stuff in the system save file, and some older savegames struggled with that. 

It should be all fixed now, and there should be no problems using your existing saves. Thanks to all the people giving us feedback, sharing their log files and testing stuff for us.

notes.title: December Update: Sexy Sketches!
notes.content:
We've got a lot of fun new things set up this month, and the team has been working like crazy to get it all in!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/af1e703b8e34b8910ba163188fa90e8745a29faf.gif[/img]
[h2]Sketches[/h2]
First up is the new Sketching Minigame; Jack's found his old sketchbook, and as inspiration strikes (and he gets to know the girls better), he'll start making drawings off them. The [url=https://discord.gg/Tsy5znC]beta testers in Discord[/url] really seemed to like them; hopefully all of you will as well :) Five of the girls get their sketch this month, we're working on sketches for the rest of them as we speak. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/6730347ec29b71e2816190afac3fa043e4c2bc01.png[/img]
[h2]Voice Overs[/h2]
Or at least moan-overs, if that's a thing. We've brought in a full cast of adult voice actors, and they've delivered 800+ new voice clips for the sex scenes of the game. All the girls now have optional voice over content for the sex scenes, and all the old scenes have been refitted to support it. Hopefully you'll enjoy it as much as the voice actresses appeared to have done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/06d0e67bcc8a60da93b590116ecbb3684a336519.png[/img]
[h2]Dynamic cameras[/h2]
We also built some new tools for spicing up the cutscenes, and we've gone through and added dynamic camera-work to every sex-scene in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/72c79449d3248c2d115aa812d0f05a1a273291b6.png[/img]
[h2]New Erotic Content[/h2]
This month's new erotic is all about Andrea; we've gotten a hot new scene with her, as well as a massive new replayable sequence for her. Poor Chastitty, who does scripting and puppeteering, swears it's the biggest scene in the game so far... we tend to believe her. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/b2904330c0e2a497bccc21a6235c97d66b08d283.png[/img]
[h2]Winter Sale[/h2]
We're going to be participating in the Winter Sale, at 25% off (our biggest discount so far).  It's a great time to get the game if you haven't, or to gift it to a friend if you already have it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/d3f63a07e3b3b2d54189104712fb25f3963d15d6.png[/img]
[h2]Main Story[/h2]
And finally, the main story of the Island continues. We get a little bit closer to discovering what's happened to Rob, and we meet a sexy new girl that may have some clues to where he's disappeared off to.

That's a lot of changes, and we'd love to hear your thoughts on them in the comments!

And with that... merry xmas. Hope you all have an amazing holiday, and we'll see you all in January!

Reyna, Miss Juicysweet Mango, dreams of becoming an entrepreneur, and with a captive audience of gorgeous girls she's setting out to test her new beauty products. Jack will help out with her many new experiments. For science, of course. Expect more fun with Mi Sun and Gabby, and finally get a chance to get to know Olga better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/9ae949a52c149f85c7867508e9a23ee595967ba2.png[/img]

Overall this update adds something like 2 hours of additional content; 3 new sex scenes, a bunch of new minigames, new relaxation activities and new outfits for the girls. We hope you like it!

notes.title: Trouble in Paradise : July Update
notes.content:
The June update ended with you finding three new girls and an abandoned airplane. The July update focuses on getting to know two of them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/6822944352cb6eb1b24b400e25851154c3e5ed2c.png[/img]

Mi Sun is a Korean streamer and pro-gamer; she's competitive, outspoken and knows what she wants, which will undoubtedly put her at collision course with some of the other girls at the resort. Explore her personality in flirting, and see if you can get close enough for a bit of night-time multiplayer gaming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/982a2c092a70c0bb57b5dca9b98e9e704ff364b9.png[/img]

On the outside, Olga's a Ukrainian party-girl and Rick's prospective trophy wife. But all is not as it seems; get to know this blond bombshell, and you'll find there's more than meets the eye.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870057/821fbdb9a188eb258c12d58b6811638dd8ad85c6.png[/img]

We're continuing to expand the list of things you can do with the girls; this time we're adding flowers. Once you unlock the opportunity you'll find there's 6 different flowers on the island, and each girl has their favorite. We also added vases to all their rooms, so they can display your gifts; it's a small thing, but one we had fun with.

In addition to that there's new questlines, new photoshoots, and Reyna wants to be an entrepreneur. Give her a helping hand, and she might give you one in return.

Hope you all like it!

notes.title: 0.8.7 hotfixes
notes.content:
We're finally pushing the various small bug-fixes and polish items we've been accumulating on the Beta branch this week to public. You can as always see the full changelog in-game (settings/changelog), but here's the TL:DR;

We fixed up a bunch of little scenes where it was possible to break progression (Cath's recurring sex scene, finding gabby, fishing with Reyna, etc). We also did a polish pass on the room art, tweaked emotions and poses for various conversations, and improved some visual effects.

Based on a player request we also added Text-to-Speech synthesizer capabilities (so having the computer say what the text does); it's not meant to be a real VO system, just provide accessability for people who struggle to read for various reasons. We've only tested this on PC, so let us know how it works on OSX/Linux. You can enable/disable it with Ctrl+V, and you can configure voices, pitch, volume etc in the Settings menu.
